opponent: DE ZERBI: “I LOVE PALHINHA LIKE THIS!”  Aston Villa
speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Jamie. Thank you, Anthony. Good evening, Roberto.  I know you were not here for the first 30 games of  
the season, but I think there is a feeling that  this was Spurs’ best performance of the season  
this evening. Watching it, what made you the most  proud? No, I am very happy, very pleased for the  
performance. We won a great game against a great  Aston Villa. Okay, they have to play Thursday,  
a very important game for them, but anyway,  it is always very tough playing against Emery,  
against this Villa, in this stadium. Very hot  stadium, very, very nice stadium. And for that  
I am really pleased. I am really pleased for  the performance with the ball, without the  
ball. Without the ball, we showed great courage,  and with the ball, great qualities. I am happy  
for this type of performance, more than three  points, because three points, okay, we are one  
point more than West Ham, but the most important  thing today, tonight, is to play a great game,  
to believe more and more in ourselves, to believe  in our qualities, and then we have to keep the  
focus to improvement. We have to do, because we  have to play like the first half for 90 minutes.  
I did not like the goal we conceded, but there are  a lot of positive things today. When you arrived,  
there was a feeling that Spurs’ biggest problem  was a lack of confidence, a squad lacking in  
confidence. Can you describe the transformation  you have seen in that regard? Listen, I am honest.  
I have one face. If I say Kolo Muani, Gallagher,  Palhinha and all our players are great level,  
big level, it is because I feel it. I do not want  to sell something if I do not believe in my words.  
I am lucky because I am working with very, very  good players, good people and very good players.  
And my work, my job, is just to transfer the  confidence, to believe in themselves and to  
try to be stronger than the defeat, stronger  than the table, the position on the table,  
stronger than the words all of you normally are  saying about Tottenham, and to show passion,  
to show value, dignity, pride. It was an  excellent performance, obviously, all round,  
but particularly after losing a player as creative  as Xavi Simons. I thought the midfield today was  
excellent. Palhinha in the middle. Bentancur,  Gallagher. They played with the ball and without  
the ball an amazing game. But Xavi Simons,  Solanke, both are top players for us. But Kolo  
Muani is different as a characteristic, but not  as a quality. You have not watched the best Kolo,  
but Kolo Muani is a top player. Mathys is very  young, but he has amazing potential as a player.  
Richarlison is playing in the Brazilian national  team. I am lucky because I have a lot of players  
now. I think the injuries are finished,  because otherwise it is a big problem. But  
I am lucky. And for that, I am not surprised.  I said two days ago in the press conference,  
if we win in Villa Park, it is not a miracle.  It was not a miracle. You said you could win  
every game from now until the end of the season  a couple of weeks ago, so you have won two in a  
row now. First time you have done so since August,  or the team have done so since August. Do you feel  
like that confidence is building within the group,  that they can continue? Yes, but the crucial thing  
now is to keep in our head what was the situation  before the Wolverhampton game. This is the most  
important memory to keep in our head, because in  football it is very easy to change. If you lose,  
you are stupid. If you win, you are a champion.  No, we have to find the balance. We have to work  
this week because Leeds is another very tough  game, and to remember in ourselves what we have  
done in the past, in the last month. Yes,  yes, but I am cool, just tired. Jason,  
you mentioned the word passion. I noticed  that every time I... Yeah. I love Palhinha  
like this. That is something you have asked for,  you have demanded? No, no. They do not have to  
follow me in this. But if I see one player  passionate, I become crazy. Ali. Roberto, were you  
surprised at all that Unai made so many changes  when you saw the team? Was there any surprise for  
the Aston Villa side? No. They have to play one  historic game Thursday. They lost three days ago,  
and I think they need two, three points,  maybe less, to achieve another very important  
target. I think when in football we love speaking  about the project, yes, in football one of the not  
too many projects is Aston Villa. In the last  four years, they have done school in terms of  
project. Because I remember the first game, the  beginning of Emery in Aston Villa, they were at  
the bottom of the table, and now they have become  one of the best teams in the Premier League. And  
they deserve everything. And in this stadium I  lost two games, but when I have played against  
Aston Villa with Emery, it has been all the  time a very, very tough game, very difficult  
to find the line, pass to everything. Go Ali  and then finish with Paul, please. Roberto,  
just quickly back on Conor Gallagher. You said you  wanted to get the Chelsea kind of version of Conor  
Gallagher back. Yeah, absolutely. When Gallagher  plays like this, we play in 12 players, because  
you can find him as a striker, as a midfielder, as  a fullback. Everywhere on the pitch you can find  
him. Great player, great passion, great qualities,  great player. Yeah, he is playing very well.  
I think with the ball he can play better, and he  knows what I mean. Maybe he is not used to playing  
a lot of balls and to take the control of the  game, but he is a great guy for sure. And no  
doubt he is going to improve quickly. No, no, no.  Paul, finish, please. You referred to the quality  
of the squad that you inherited. Does it continue  to surprise you that this team, this squad of  
players, is struggling against relegation rather  than challenging for Champions League places?  
Yes, I am surprised, but you have to consider  the league we are playing. Premier League  
is tough. If you suffer so many injuries,  if you do not find a win for a long time,  
if you lose the confidence in yourself,  game by game it becomes worse and worse,  
and you have to stop. You have to find  the right momentum to restart. Just it.  
But also Nottingham Forest is an important team,  important club, important players, and one month  
ago they were in a very bad situation, and in  Premier League it can happen. Okay, thank you.
title: DE ZERBI: “I LOVE PALHINHA LIKE THIS!”  Aston Villa 1-2 Tottenham
